opportunities.exact_theorem: For every countable G0 and finite characteristic-two field F with ab=1 and ba!=1 in F[G0], putting |F|=2^d and G=(G0 x C_(2^d-1))*Z yields h_WP(G acting on uniform F2^G)=infinity. G is finitely presented if G0 is. Its binary coordinate generator gives h_Rok<=log(2).
opportunities.quantifier_boundary: The conclusion applies to the explicitly enlarged group G. It does not establish it for G0, does not make G torsion-free, and does not supply any witness a,b from an existential target.
opportunities.ambitious_endpoint: A verified finite power of this defect is Bernoulli, yielding an unequal-base-entropy Bernoulli conjugacy.
opportunities.scoped_technical_result: Exact finite cyclic field-corner transfer and free-product kernel repair permit N252/N253 to apply under the actual finite-field/torsion comparator premises; complete Haar-preserving inverse supplied.
opportunities.historical_importance: A binary shift with arbitrarily large independent Bernoulli direct factors and a finite generating partition would show a sharp divergence between weak-Pinsker and Rokhlin entropy for an actual nonsf group, if the group-ring premise is independently validated.
opportunities.new_mechanism_in_this_campaign: Embed F_{2^d} as a CRT corner of F2[C_(2^d-1)], add the complementary identity to the one-sided inverse, then pass to a free product with Z so the finite normal action kernel disappears.
opportunities.load_bearing_missing_lemma: For the witnessed defect K=im(1-ba) after enlargement, K^(|SS^-1|+1) is a nontrivial Bernoulli action. The present construction proves only an independent Bernoulli factor and does not supply an iid generating partition.
compatibility_obligations: Validate the actual finite-characteristic-two one-sided group-ring inverse; comparator files containing sorry are target statements.
Keep finite-field and original-group changes explicit.
Retain the standard-Borel mod-null interface and Haar product independence from the whole residual.
Do not cancel the residual or descend a tensor-product statement to an individual binary factor.
opportunities.early_falsification: Normal finite averaging idempotents show that an unchecked torsion-bearing action kernel blocks the extraction. Finite-gradient Popa quotients show that finite dependence and finite powers do not imply Bernoullicity.
opportunities.likely_significance_if_fully_established: The premise repair supports a short structural consequence of a validated non-direct-finiteness counterexample. The remaining Bernoulli conjugacy theorem would be a major advance; no proof of it is obtained.

residual_bernoulllicity_priority.assessment: Mathematically decisive and high significance, but low tractability from the current information. It is a special instance of the nonamenable complemented-Bernoulli-factor problem and needs an actual iid generating argument. Kernel repair and finite extraction do not materially prove this lemma.
